errors.text_span: Ценова стратегия на база ценност на клиента
errors.evidence: The full category label on the x-axis is "Ценова стратегия на база ценност на продукта за клиента". The description omits the words "на продукта".

errors.text_span: Оста е маркирана с линейна скала, варираща от 0 до 60%, с равномерни интервали от 5%.
errors.evidence: This sentence describes the vertical (value) axis, but it is placed immediately after the description of the horizontal (category) axis without any transition, making it unclear which axis is being described.
The labeled tick marks on the vertical axis are at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60), not 5%.
The description introduces the idea that firms are "numbered from top to bottom," which is information that does not exist in the chart.
The description claims the bars are in random order, but they are clearly sorted in descending order of value from left to right (49.3%, 31.5%, 19.2%).
